iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/download -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_2021_hylo
cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download if update flag is set:
if do_update == 1 then
wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip 'https://scholarship.miami.edu/view/fileRedirect?instCode=01UOML_INST&filePid=13395678880002976&download=true' 2>&1

# unzip to download directory if update flag is set
if do_update == 1 then
unzip -o download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip -d download && rm download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip 2>&1

# load raster into postGIS with:
    raster2pgsql -s 3857 -d -C -I -t 48x48 GeoTIFF_Rasters/Water_Euclid_Dist_30m_MDC.tif -F mdc_distance_to_water > load_raster.sql
psql <connection options> < load_raster.sql
rm load_raster.sql

# create color raster
mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_distance_to_water
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/derived
cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo
cat > /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/derived/mdc_distance_to_water_color_ramp.txt <<_EOF
0 171 198 230 255
150 171 198 230 230
330 171 198 230 199
525 171 198 230 166
720 171 198 230 133
915 171 198 230 99
1110 171 198 230 66
1305 171 198 230 33
1500 171 198 230 0
_EOF
gdaldem color-relief download/GeoTIFF_Rasters/Water_Euclid_Dist_30m_MDC.tif /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/derived/mdc_distance_to_water_color_ramp.txt /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/derived/mdc_distance_to_water_color.tif -alpha
# create color raster and render raster tiles 
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/derived
mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_distance_to_water
cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo
echo "" | base64 -d > /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/derived/mdc_distance_to_water_legend.png
cp /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/derived/mdc_distance_to_water_legend.png /tiles/raster/mdc_distance_to_water/
# render raster tiles 
cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/
gdal2tiles.py -ex --xyz -z 8-16 /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_water/derived/mdc_distance_to_water_color.tif /tiles/raster/mdc_distance_to_water
